messages:
Izzy: Heads-up — Acme Labs wants Hummingbird-22B onboarded for their private deployment. They want a quantized 4-bit variant and ~=150ms p95 for 512 tokens on our dedicated tier. Can we run a quick compatibility + bring-up checklist?
Eli: Quick q — which tokenizer? BPE or SentencePiece? Tokenizer differences can change prompt lengths and perf.
Izzy: They said BPE, same vocab as open-hb/v1. I'll upload the model tar to S3: s3://acme-hb/hummingbird-22b.tar.gz.
Matt: I can take quant part. Plan: GPTQ -> nf4/PTQ pipeline, then run small-kernel perf tests. Need to know if rotary or ALiBi positional encodings — affects kernel selection.
Sasha: Model config says rotary_emb: true, rotary_base: 10000. Also head_dim=128 and num_heads=64. That head dim should be fine for fused-attn on CUDA, but we need to confirm multiples for the H100 kernels.
Ravi: On infra side — the customer will be on Dedicated (A100s for now). H100 kernels are a nice-to-have. For A100: check cuBLAS/FlashAttention variants and ensure our runtime picks the right kernels. Also confirm KV cache memory: 512 token seq + 2048 context? clarify.
Izzy: They plan to use 2048 context in production. For the perf target, priority is latency over throughput.
Matt: Notes for quant flow: 
```
- generate fp16 baseline perf on A100 (512/2048)
- run GPTQ nf4 4-bit with group size 128
- validate exact logits on a set of 50 eval prompts (per-customer golden set)
- run perf sweep: batch sizes [1,2,4], seq [128,512,2048]
- run quality evals (PPL + 5 human eval prompts)
```
Need the eval prompts from CS.
Sasha: Potential blocker: Rotary implementation in our runtime currently assumes sin/cos precompute layout X. Hummingbird's rotary uses variant Y (interleaved). Might need a small patch to the rotary kernel. Could do a compatibility shim but better to patch for correctness.
Ravi: Also check tokenizer special tokens — do we need to map eos/unk IDs? If we mismatch, stopping behavior changes and evals are invalid.
DeployBot: model-upload: hummingbird-22b.tar.gz verified, sha256=3ac2... , size=86.4GB, artifacts: model.bin, config.json, tokenizer.json.
Izzy: OK, action items: Matt runs quant experiments + quality evals, Sasha tries to reproduce rotary mismatch and evaluate patch impact, Eli sanity-checks tokenizer mapping, Ravi verifies runtime kernel availability on A100 images and logs any missing drivers/kernels. I'll coordinate with CS for the eval prompt set.
Matt: I'll post initial GPTQ diff results by EOD tomorrow. Quick ask: do we have a standard script for perf runs I should use?
Sasha: Use infra/tools/run_perf.sh with --model-path and --cuda-kernel-override to test variants. If rotary patch needed, create a small feature branch and tag it rc/hb-rotary-compat.
Eli: I'll dump the tokenizer mapping and sample tokenized prompts here in a sec.
Izzy: If anyone hits a hard block (kernel or correctness), escalate to eng-runtime. Let's keep this thread for triage. :thumbsup:
Matt: ping when the eval set is uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/hummingbird-22b/golden.jsonl
Ravi: Confirmed A100 nodes have flash-attn v1 and cuBLAS 11.8. Will spin a test instance and share access by noon.
Sasha: small reminder — watch out for attention mask shape changes when changing seq len; unit tests should catch it.
Izzy: Thanks team. I'll update the onboarding ticket with this checklist and assignees.
Matt: :thumbsup:
Eli: Uploaded tokenizer check: sample -> "Hello world" -> tokens [154, 23, 2], eos=2. Looks consistent.
DeployBot: infra-test: perf-run job submitted (job id 45219).
Izzy: Last note — CS wants a go/no-go by Friday EOD for Dedicated pilot. Prioritize quant baseline + quality smoke.
Sasha: Understood. Starting rotary compat branch now.
Matt: will post preliminary numbers in thread when job finishes.
